meta.description: Measures how loud a room is, from a small microphone board: the sound level, a spectrum by pitch and, if you want, a room acoustics dashboard.

m5stack-atom-echos3r.description: A palm-sized ESP32-S3 board with a microphone, a sound chip and Wi-Fi, powered over USB.
m5stack-atom-echos3r.does: Runs ESPHome as a room sound sensor. Every second it reports the loudness and the loudest peak, five times a second a spectrum in 31 bands from deep bass to treble, and it can stream a faster reading on demand. It listens only: the speaker amplifier on the board stays off.
